slides.texte_overlay:
6 weird skills a
dangerous man possesses

1. Jump-starting a car
Red to red, black to metal.
You help the stranger
in the parking lot.

2. Finding north
without a phone
The sun rises in the east
and sets in the west.
You always know your way.

3. Knowing the story
behind things
Why that bridge was built,
who painted that picture.
People lean in when you talk.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Knowing the story
behind things
Learn one a day on the
Sophia app: history, science
or art in 5 minutes.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Sewing a button back on
Two minutes, needle and thread.
Your shirt lives
another five years.

5. Splitting the bill
in your head
Quick, fair, no phone out.
Small thing. People notice.

6. Staying calm when
someone panics
Slow voice, simple steps.
Your calm becomes theirs.
